title: Upconversion materials: a new frontier in solar water-splitting
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,1643-1661

Yerbolat Magazov, Asset Aliyev, Nursaya Zhumabay, Zhamilya Taubaldiyeva, Guldana Zhigerbayeva, Nurxat Nuraje
Upconversion unlocks sub-bandgap photons for solar water splitting. This review compares Ln-based and TTA-based systems, outlining mechanisms, synthesis, and integration strategies to advance solar-to-hydrogen efficiency.
